paper_claims.claim: MaP-WAM achieves 83.3% total average success rate on RMBench, outperforming LingBot-VA (77.1%), Mem-0 (42.0%), and pi0.5 (10.4%).
On Swap T and Press Button tasks, MaP-WAM achieves 96% success rate on both tasks.
On real-world Franka FR3 arm, MaP-WAM achieves 88% on Find Button and 68% on Press Buttons (where baselines achieve 0%).
MaP-WAM maintains an approximately constant ~827ms per-chunk executor inference latency regardless of history length, whereas full-context causal WAM suffers OOM at 1,700 frames (>80GB).
Without progress calibration via plan-observation alignment, performance on Blocks Ranking Try collapses from 94% to 38%.
Without progress condition p_t, performance on Press Button collapses from 96% to 18% due to visual ambiguity between pressing and releasing.
